title: Where is my product key for Office 365?
description: ​If your purchase came with a product key, you'll need that to redeem or renew your subscription. We'll help you find it.​​​ ​  For more help, visit https://support.office.com/.

asr.full_text: this is ryan from office and today we're gonna help you find your office product key a project is a 25 character alphanumeric code that's used to redeem your initial office 365 purchase or to renew a subscription it looks like this once you've redeemed it you don't actually need it anymore. But...let's say you do now. Where is it? Well, that actually depends on how you got office. So let's talk through the scenarios. Now if you bought office at a store, your Office 365 subscription either came in a box like this, and your product key is on a card inside like this or your product key is on a subscription card like this one and it's on the back under this silver area that you can actually scratch off. Now this is also true for Office 2016. If you downloaded office from an online store, your product keys should be in your email receipt. But in case it's not, check with your retailer it might be embedded within the install link. Have other questions about Microsoft Office? Check out the other Office help videos. We're here to help you.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is an instructional Office 365 support tutorial explaining how product keys are used to redeem a purchase or renew a subscription. It gives ordinary guidance for locating keys in retail boxes, subscription cards, and online-store receipts, while showing an Office 365 package and Microsoft logo without requesting money, credentials, investment participation, or an unrelated benefit.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an operational technology tutorial explaining how product keys work and where viewers can locate them across retail and online-purchase scenarios.
